{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Identify and exclude refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Define population: exclude QA and refunded orders
population_mask = ~(qa_mask | refunded_mask)
filtered_df = df[population_mask]

# Compute conversion rate for each channel in the population
conversion_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Print the raw conversion rates by channel
print(f"Raw conversion rates by channel:\n{conversion_by_channel}")

# Also print the number of refunded orders and total filtered
num_refunded = refunded_mask.sum()
num_filtered = filtered_df.shape[0]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}")
print(f"Total orders after filtering (excluding QA and refunded): {num_filtered}")"}
